correctness.rationale: For even N and triangle-free H_N, every allowable-edge greedy step reduces vacancies by two and cannot stop with k≥3; a terminal two-set must be forbidden. For each forbidden e, exact conditional one-step survival is (binom(k−2,2)−h0)/(binom(k,2)−1−h0−h1), with baseline s0=(k−3)/(k+1). One-step degree-bounded r-mark comparisons give uniform survival ΘΔ((k/N)^r) for r=2,3,4 above fixed L, hence conditional counts E[h0|e] = OΔ(k²/N), E[h1|e]=OΔ(k/N). Their relative survival correction OΔ(1/(Nk)) telescopes with logN/N loss. At fixed final L, all extra forbidden edges disappear conditionally with probability 1−OΔ(1/N). Baseline product yields 3/(N²−1); summing disjoint forbidden final pairs gives 3m_N/(N²−1)(1+OΔ(logN/N)). Independently computed exact subset recursions: single forbidden edge n4=1/5,n6=3/35,n8=1/21,n10=1/33; forbidden cycles n6=1/3,n8=212/825,n10=178177/825825. These finite checks do not prove uniform asymptotics.
